cosmin.look: Cosmin, a fourteen-year-old cooper's boy from Vallaki, thin and a full head shorter than a grown man, with short messy dark-brown hair, a smudged freckled boy's face with a stubborn chin, wearing a patched oatmeal-coloured wool jacket with rolled sleeves over a brown shirt, worn brown breeches and scuffed boots, a heavy grey-brown horse blanket rolled over one shoulder and tied across his chest with rope, and a crude wooden sword (a carved plank with a crosspiece) held in his right hand
cosmin.who: Cosmin, a fourteen-year-old cooper's boy with a horse blanket rolled over his shoulder and a wooden sword
cosmin.windup: the wooden sword raised high over his right shoulder in both hands, a fierce stubborn face, blanket swinging
cosmin.strike: the wooden sword swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the blow

guardian_of_faith.look: a spectral guardian from Guardian of Faith, a Large hovering figure of pale golden light, indistinct and faceless under a hood, its robes fading into wisps of light below the knees so that its feet never touch the ground, holding a gleaming silver longsword in its right hand pointed down at its side and carrying a gleaming round silver shield on its left arm emblazoned with a golden sunburst, the whole figure one uniform pale gold and cream colour in every view (hood, robe, wisps and back), with no red or purple anywhere
guardian_of_faith.who: a spectral guardian, a faceless hooded figure of pale golden light hovering above the ground, with a gleaming silver longsword and a round silver shield bearing a golden sunburst
guardian_of_faith.windup: the longsword drawn back and raised beside its head, the shield held out in front, leaning back
guardian_of_faith.strike: the longsword swung forward and down at the enemy at full arm's length, the shield pulled in, leaning into the blow
